Load hoopR NBA Stats hustle stats

Source: R/load_nba_stats_extra.R
load_nba_stats_hustle.Rd

load_nba_stats_hustle_player() and load_nba_stats_hustle_team() load the nba_stats_hustle release: eight files per season (leaguehustlestats{player|team}_{season_type}_{per_mode}_{END year}.parquet), contested shots, deflections, charges drawn, screen assists, loose balls and box-outs. The requested season types and per modes (all of them by default) are bound into one frame, with season_type and per_mode columns saying which file a row came from.

Usage

load_nba_stats_hustle_player(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  season_type = NULL,
  per_mode = NULL,
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_nba_stats_hustle_team(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  season_type = NULL,
  per_mode = NULL,
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_stats_hustle release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_stats_hustle, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years – the season's START year (e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season). Published coverage starts at 2015 (2015-16). Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season.

season_type

"regular-season" and/or "playoffs"; NULL (the default) reads both.

per_mode

"pergame" and/or "totals"; NULL reads both.

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player per season type per per mode (load_nba_stats_hustle_player()).

col_nametypesdescription
player_idintegerstats.nba.com player identifier (PERSON_ID); joins to every other nba_stats loader.
player_namecharacterPlayer's full name as stats.nba.com lists it (e.g. 'Nikola Jokic').
team_idintegerstats.nba.com team identifier.
team_abbreviationcharacterTeam tricode (e.g. 'BOS').
agenumericPlayer age in years at the season's reference date, as stats.nba.com reports it.
gintegerGames played in the split.
minnumericMinutes played (per game in 'pergame' files, season total in 'totals' files).
contested_shotsintegerShots the player (or team) contested.
contested_shots_2_ptintegerTwo-point shots contested.
contested_shots_3_ptintegerThree-point shots contested.
deflectionsintegerDeflections of opponent passes or dribbles.
charges_drawnintegerOffensive fouls (charges) drawn.
screen_assistsintegerScreens set that led directly to a teammate's made field goal.
screen_ast_ptsintegerPoints scored on field goals created by the screen assists.
off_loose_balls_recoveredintegerLoose balls recovered on offense.
def_loose_balls_recoveredintegerLoose balls recovered on defense.
loose_balls_recoveredintegerLoose balls recovered (offense plus defense).
pct_loose_balls_recovered_offnumericShare (0-1) of loose-ball recoveries made on offense.
pct_loose_balls_recovered_defnumericShare (0-1) of loose-ball recoveries made on defense.
off_boxoutsintegerBox-outs on offense.
def_boxoutsintegerBox-outs on defense.
box_out_player_team_rebsintegerRebounds secured by the player's team on the player's box-outs.
box_out_player_rebsintegerRebounds secured by the player himself on his own box-outs.
box_outsintegerBox-outs executed (offense plus defense).
pct_box_outs_offnumericShare (0-1) of box-outs made on offense.
pct_box_outs_defnumericShare (0-1) of box-outs made on defense.
pct_box_outs_team_rebnumericShare (0-1) of the player's box-outs that ended in a team rebound.
pct_box_outs_rebnumericShare (0-1) of the player's box-outs that ended in his own rebound.
seasonintegerEND year of the NBA season (2025 = 2024-25) – the published asset's own stamp, one more than the seasons argument.
season_typecharacterSeason type of the source file: 'regular-season' or 'playoffs' (the release file-name token).
per_modecharacterAggregation of the source file: 'pergame' (per-game averages) or 'totals' (season totals); stamped from the file name when the rows lack it.

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per team per season type per per mode (load_nba_stats_hustle_team()).

team_idintegerstats.nba.com team identifier.

See also

The publishing pipeline, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data, and the Python twins sportsdataverse.nba.load_nba_stats_hustle_player() / load_nba_stats_hustle_team().

Other NBA Stats loader functions: load_nba_stats_coaches(), load_nba_stats_draft_combine, load_nba_stats_game_matchups(), load_nba_stats_injury_report(), load_nba_stats_leaguedash(), load_nba_stats_matchups(), load_nba_stats_metric_curves(), load_nba_stats_rolling_windows(), load_nba_stats_synergy()
